causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand in New South Wales was high, reaching a maximum for the day of 13 412 MW at 4.30 pm.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The unplanned outage of Delta Electricity's Wallerawang unit eight at 3.33 pm led to a significant change in dispatch in order to manage network constraints in the vicinity.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 3.34 pm Delta Electricity rebid the unit's available capacity from 500 MW to zero (380 MW of this capacity was priced below zero). This reduction in the availability of Wallerawang led to a violation of the constraint managing the Mt Piper to Wallerawang 330 kV lines... The 5-minute price increased from $75/MWh at 3.35 pm to $10 000/MWh at 3.40 pm.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 3.35 pm Delta Electricity rebid the ramp down rate of Mount Piper units one and two... The rebid reduced the ramp down rate on each unit from 5 MW/min to the minimum allowable of 3 MW/min.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: Following the loss of Wallerawang unit eight, the system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S violated from 3.40 pm to 4 pm inclusive.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The violation of this constraint led to flows into New South Wales across all interconnectors (QNI, Terranora and Vic-NSW) exceeding their import limits for the same period.

constraints_named.quote: Following the loss of Wallerawang unit eight, the system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S violated from 3.40 pm to 4 pm inclusive.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: The violation of this constraint led to flows into New South Wales across all interconnectors (QNI, Terranora and Vic-NSW) exceeding their import limits for the same period.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: The violation of this constraint led to flows into New South Wales across all interconnectors (QNI, Terranora and Vic-NSW) exceeding their import limits for the same period.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: The violation of this constraint led to flows into New South Wales across all interconnectors (QNI, Terranora and Vic-NSW) exceeding their import limits for the same period.

intervals.quote: The 5-minute price increased from $75/MWh at 3.35 pm to $10 000/MWh at 3.40 pm. The price remained at the cap until 4 pm, after which it fell significantly (the 5-minute price for the 4.05 pm dispatch interval was $17/MWh).

peak_price.quote: The 5-minute price increased from $75/MWh at 3.35 pm to $10 000/MWh at 3.40 pm.

rebid_set_price.quote: At 3.34 pm Delta Electricity rebid the unit's available capacity from 500 MW to zero (380 MW of this capacity was priced below zero). This reduction in the availability of Wallerawang led to a violation of the constraint managing the Mt Piper to Wallerawang 330 kV lines... The 5-minute price increased from $75/MWh at 3.35 pm to $10 000/MWh at 3.40 pm.
